name: interp1
expr: r1 = interp1(x,y,1.5); r2 = interp1(x,y,2.5); r3 = interp1(x,y,1); pn = interp1(x,y,1.5,'next'); pp = interp1(x,y,1.5,'previous'); pk = interp1(x,y,2,'next'); oob = interp1(x,y,3.5,'previous'); sq = interp1(x,y,1.4,"nearest"); se = interp1(x,y,4,"linear","extrap"); sf = interp1(x,y,4,"linear",99);
comment: Sig r=interp1(x,y,xq[,method][,extrap]). linear (default), nearest, spline, pchip, makima, previous/next; queries outside [x(1),x(end)] -> NaN by default. DEEP-PROBE 2026-05-31: the method and extrapval args now accept STRING ("nearest") as well as char ('nearest') -- MATLAB accepts both; numkit previously honored only char and SILENTLY IGNORED a double-quoted method (interp1(x,y,1.4,"nearest") gave linear 14 instead of 10). sq=interp1(x,y,1.4,"nearest")=10; se=interp1(x,y,4,"linear","extrap")=40 (method extrapolation); sf=interp1(x,y,4,"linear",99)=99 (scalar fill). namespace=builtin. Matches MATLAB R2025b.
